covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Wednesday, October 28, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Thursday, October 29, 2026 U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: The Federal Reserve decision and Chair press conference occur shortly before the after-close reports; AI-capex scrutiny, elevated oil, valuation sensitivity and Thursday GDP/PCE data can amplify or overwhelm company-specific reactions.

consensus_method.description: Three independent evidence reviews on one fixed qualified universe; displayed scores and reversal risk are arithmetic means.
consensus_method.disparity_scale: 0-100; combines spread in the three direction and reversal-risk assessments, with lower values indicating tighter agreement.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Cloud acceleration and resilient Search favor upside, but record AI spending makes guidance the decisive override.

ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: 2027 capex rises faster than monetization or free cash flow.
